title: bidirectional_account_transfer
summary: Two threads transfer funds in opposite directions between two mutex-protected bank accounts, incrementing a completed-transfers counter and computing a local receipt number, with deadlock freedom and completion guarantees.

domain_types.name: Account
domain_types.description: Bank account with balance and pure deposit/withdraw methods

clauses.text: Both transfer threads must eventually finish.
Each transfer locks both accounts at the same time (atomic acquisition of both mutexes).
Each completed transfer increments the completed-transfers counter.
Account stores balance and supports pure deposit/withdraw operations.
Each transfer computes a simple receipt number locally.

requirements.text: Both transfer threads must eventually finish.
Each transfer locks both accounts at the same time (atomic acquisition of both mutexes).
Each completed transfer increments the completed-transfers counter.
Account stores balance and supports pure deposit/withdraw operations.
Each transfer computes a simple receipt number locally.

source_nl: Simulate two threads transferring funds in opposite directions between two bank accounts (Account A and Account B), where each account is protected by its own mutex. Each transfer locks both accounts at the same time, increments a completed-transfers counter, and computes a simple receipt number locally. Ensure the program never deadlocks and both transfer threads finish.
